correctness.rationale: A complete 392-face augmented-poset enumeration and a 191-pair ordinary acyclic discrete-Morse matching leave one critical vertex and nine critical 3-cells. All 1200 oriented Hasse cover relations are checked by a full topological sort. Thus the integral homotopy type is nine S^3. Every one of 1920 explicit automorphisms preserves all five graph edge directions and has Lefschetz character independently computed from signed invariant faces; the character agrees exactly with epsilon tensor (standard4 plus five weight-four characters). Transfer for finite group quotients yields invariant dimensions 4 and 0. All checks replayed using included checker; no finite experiment is extrapolated to an infinite family.

value.rationale: The folded five-cube is a canonical distance-transitive strongly regular graph with full Weyl D5 symmetry, not an arbitrary slice. An integral nine-sphere classification combined with the complete 1920-element rational homology representation distinguishes ordinary third Betti number nine, translation quotient rank four and full-symmetry quotient rank zero. This identifies the intrinsic weight-four translation characters and provides a natural rigorous example for symmetry-sensitive combinatorial topology.
